item.title: NYC Health + Hospitals — Procurement: Rubrik Enterprise
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
MetroPlus is seeking qualified resellers capable of providing Rubrik an enterprise-wide backup solution that protects our virtual servers and Isilon file shares. There is also a ransomware detection piece that is utilized to inspect our backups for known malware. Support is required to keep our backup system and its components up to date and patched at the latest levels.

item.title: Education — Procurement: Requirements Contracts for Public School Athletic League Insurance and Benefits
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The New York City Public Schools ( NYCPS ), on behalf of the Public Schools Athletic League ( PSAL ), is establishing a requirements contract for a comprehensive student accident insurance program. To fulfill the ongoing needs of the league, PSAL is seeking proposals from qualified insurance carriers, agencies, brokers, or authorized third-party administrators ('Proposers'). The selected provider will deliver accident, medical, and dental insurance coverage, alongside related claims administration services, for eligible participants in PSAL-sponsored interscholastic athletic activities.
